title: Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino (Theme 11: Ushuru)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child keeps the ji- that belongs to the noun, adds ki- for small (kijiwe) or ji- for big, and changes the agreement to KI-VI or LI-YA.

floor.prerequisite: Makes big and small forms of ki- nouns.
floor.question: Udogo wa "kitabu" ni?

steps: Check the noun starts with ji- that is part of it.
contexts: taxes (ushuru): a small stone on a toll road
a story of a giant's eye

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "kijiwe" and "Kijiwe kimeanguka" and the plural "Vijiwe vimeanguka".

misconceptions.ask: Ukiondoa ji-, kinabaki neno lenye maana?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa nomino za ji- kama jiwe, ji- inabaki: kijiwe.

misconceptions.ask: Jicho ni jicho la kawaida au jicho kubwa sana?
misconceptions.repair: Jicho ni hali ya wastani; ukubwa wake ni jijicho.

misconceptions.ask: Kijiwe kiko katika ngeli ipi? Wingi wake huanza na nini?
